paper: AlphaSchema: Exploring the Space of Trading Semantics for LLM-Based Alpha Mining
headline_agent: semantic-schema search, LLM code realization, reward-model navigation, exported factor pools, LightGBM combination, and Qlib Top-50/drop-5 strategy
component_selection_reason: The production factor pools and combiner are withheld, but Appendix D presents one complete cross-sectional factor program, identifies its source schema, fixes best_period=20, and reports positive train/validation/test Rank IC. It is the only source-selected executable factor output and was fixed before new JKP inspection.
source_mechanism: Cross-sectionally z-score price-volume synergy and distance from a moving-average reference, combine them, downweight repeated events through causal EWMA cooldown, preserve the synergy direction, and apply causal event-memory smoothing.

monthly_adapter.bar_mapping: One source day becomes one JKP month; period=20 and both EWMA spans retain their source integer values as months.
monthly_adapter.inputs: Absolute JKP formation-month prc supplies close; JKP tvol supplies volume; the source's explicit moving-average fallback replaces unavailable VWAP.
monthly_adapter.universe: The common formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. equities; same-date cross-sectional normalization is calculated within that universe.
monthly_adapter.portfolio: Researcher-supplied common value-weighted long/short deciles from the literal positive factor score.
monthly_adapter.costs: Common 0/5/10/25/50 bp one-way cases with 10 bp primary.
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: Fixed holdings re-accounted under zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking or reweighting.
monthly_adapter.history: A 60-month pre-formation buffer initializes price changes and EWM state; unavailable monthly observations are not forward-filled.

preserved: moving-average fallback when VWAP is absent
adapted: daily CSI300 bars to monthly U.S. JKP bars
